items.title: Delete the three unused sample/dogfood packages (cli-guess-number, python-demo, python-rps) and scrub residual references
items.context: Remove packages/cli-guess-number, packages/python-demo, packages/python-rps entirely (git rm -r). Verify nothing else references them: grep for each name across the repo (excluding node_modules/.git/.worktrees/.lattice/dist) returns only matches inside the deleted dirs (zero after deletion); confirm no tsconfig references[] / path mapping and no root package.json entry. After deletion `npm run build` and `npm run test:e2e` must still pass.
items.userSees: packages/ contains only lab, main, utils; `npm run build` and `npm run test:e2e` still pass with the sample packages gone.

happy.desc: After git rm -r, ls packages/ lists exactly lab, main, utils and nothing else → exit 0; WHY: confirms all three sample dirs removed and only product packages remain

git ls-files --error-unmatch packages/cli-guess-number packages/python-demo packages/python-rps each returns exit 1 → all three dirs fully untracked from git index; WHY: confirms deletion is committed to git, not just rm on disk
npm run build exits 0 after deletion → no broken references in TypeScript compilation; WHY: confirms no tsconfig paths or import references depended on deleted packages
npm run test:e2e exits 0 after deletion → end-to-end tests unaffected; WHY: confirms test:authority-live-python* use tmpdir, not the deleted sample dirs

edge.desc: grep -r cli-guess-number across repo (excluding node_modules/.git/.worktrees/.lattice/dist) returns zero matches → no stale references in tsconfig, root package.json, scripts, or docs; WHY: catches partial cleanup where dirs deleted but references left behind

grep -r python-demo and grep -r python-rps across repo (same exclusions) each return zero matches → no stale references to either python sample; WHY: python samples had koala.config.json that might be referenced somewhere

Deleted dirs do not exist on disk even as empty directories: test -d packages/cli-guess-number and test -d packages/python-demo and test -d packages/python-rps all return false; WHY: git rm -r should remove from disk too, but a partial git rm might leave empty parent dirs

adversarial.desc: packages/lab directory still exists and contains expected files (package.json) → over-deletion guard; WHY: glob-based deletion (rm -r packages/p*) could accidentally catch packages/lab if mistyped pattern

packages/main and packages/utils still exist with their package.json → over-deletion guard for product packages; WHY: a broad packages/* glob or faulty script could delete product packages alongside samples
experiments/ directory still exists and is git-tracked → out-of-scope deletion guard; WHY: story explicitly defers experiments/ cleanup to separate story; overzealous cleanup agent might delete it
CLAUDE.md, README.md, AGENTS.md, CHANGELOG.md still exist at repo root → root file survival guard; WHY: a glob-based rm at root (rm *.md or similar) could accidentally nuke critical documentation

Root package.json does not reference cli-guess-number as a workspace entry → workspace/tsconfig reference guard; WHY: if root package.json had a workspaces entry for deleted package, npm install would fail or produce warnings post-deletion

items.title: Delete the two tracked cruft files (du.exe.stackdump, claude-session.mjs) and scrub residual references
items.context: git rm du.exe.stackdump and claude-session.mjs at repo root. (jek.md is user-owned and intentionally NOT touched.) claude-session.mjs has no live import (claude-cli.ts:58 is a coincidental '.tmp-claude-session' string; docs/metadata/task.json only cites it historically) — leaving that historical doc note is acceptable. After deletion `npm run build` and `npm run test:e2e` must still pass.
items.userSees: `git ls-files` no longer lists du.exe.stackdump or claude-session.mjs; jek.md is still present and tracked; build and e2e still pass.
